asset_provenance: User-authorized single-image web generation from approved 109x110 source crop; exact original PNG retained by hash.

registration_landmarks.transform_policy: One translation and one positive uniform scale. No independent XY stretch.

foot_explanation.north_bar: Visible north facade ground contacts measured on downloaded body, independent of south-front depth.
foot_explanation.west_wing: West upper wing contact row follows its lower edge before south-front return.
foot_explanation.east_wing: East lower block and side return contact row measured from actual facade edge.
foot_explanation.central_low_roof: Connected low roof and its short facade remain solid, with the visible low facade foot row. Transparent courtyard cores remain excluded.
foot_explanation.south_front: Last >=0.97 solid-alpha south-front source texel in each raw column, interpolated only across empty columns.
foot_explanation.collision: All three existing native StaticBody2D children and source polygons remain unchanged; visual rows never modify physics or route permission.

ground.reason: Generated border trees are excluded. Only a uniform sample of plain generated paving fills the hand-reviewed original building ownership mask; true courtyards, original trees and roads keep exact original pixels.
